name: button
title: Button
description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.
author: Mzizi, operated by Nyuchi Africa (Pvt) Ltd — https://mzizi.dev
docs:
Use it for: Primary CTA (mineral accent), Secondary action (outline/ghost), Destructive action (delete, remove), Icon-only action, Link-style navigation.
Variants: default, outline, secondary, ghost, destructive, link.
Sizes: default (49px on touch, 36px at desktop density), sm (49px on touch, 33px at desktop density), lg (56px on touch, 41px at desktop density), icon (49px square on touch, 36px at desktop density), icon-sm (49px on touch, 33px at desktop density).
Includes: No styling class: data-slot, data-variant, data-size and data-state carry the state, Look in styles/pattern/mzizi-theme.css; minimums in styles/pattern/floor.css, asChild support via Radix Slot, Disabled is the native attribute, mirrored to data-state.
Accessibility: Focus-visible ring with --ring token, aria-invalid styling, Bundu hit region: 45px on touch, 24px on a desktop (floor.css), Keyboard accessible (Enter/Space).
Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://api.mzizi.dev/v1/ui/button
